globalRules.photoStyle: clean contemporary Japanese salon editorial photography with structured composition
globalRules.audience: women who have not fully decided hairstyle/color and want help translating vague preferences into concrete choices
avoid: visible third-party logos or copyrighted salon branding not supplied by the store
globalRules.commercialUsagePolicy: Generated or acquired assets remain UNKNOWN until usage rights are explicitly confirmed. Do not mark CONFIRMED automatically.

assets.composition: Japanese woman in her late 20s-40s, natural light, refined contemporary hair, clear face-framing silhouette, structured negative space for copy
assets.prompt: Photorealistic contemporary beauty editorial in a clean Japanese hair salon. Japanese woman in her late 20s to 40s with a refined, natural hairstyle that clearly shows face-framing shape and hair texture. Bright soft natural light, off-white background, restrained taupe and neutral charcoal details, approachable and sophisticated rather than luxurious. Realistic hair texture, no text, no logos. Leave structured negative space for landing-page headline. Avoid pink/lavender gradients, dark luxury mood and extreme fashion posing.
assets.alt: 明るいサロン空間で顔まわりと髪の質感が分かる女性スタイル

assets.composition: mirror-side dialogue using hairstyle references or gestures to compare directions; collaborative choice-making
assets.prompt: Photorealistic documentary-style consultation scene in a clean contemporary Japanese hair salon. A Japanese female client and stylist talk naturally in front of a mirror, comparing hairstyle directions through gestures and subtle reference discussion. The scene communicates collaborative decision support based on face shape, hair texture and everyday styling. Bright off-white light, restrained taupe and neutral charcoal details, calm confidence, no visible logos or text.
assets.alt: 鏡の前で似合う方向を一緒に具体化する女性客と美容師

assets.composition: three clearly differentiated style directions demonstrating face framing, texture and practical wearability; structured comparison layout
assets.prompt: Photorealistic editorial triptych for a contemporary Japanese hair salon showing three distinct but realistic hairstyle directions for Japanese women. Each image clearly differs in face-framing shape, texture and silhouette while remaining wearable and refined. Bright clean off-white palette with restrained taupe and charcoal details, realistic shine and texture, structured comparison feel, no text, no logos, no exaggerated before-after styling.
